recommendation: Consider one separately registered, post-result check of model ranking at the identified step-2 task-choice disagreement. It can explain this callback's ordering, not the full game's financial difference.
proposed_scope: Bind the accepted model and existing trace; select the same-input disagreement by a fixed identity rule and perform at most one CPU forward on its full candidate set, with at most 8192 rows. A second paired trace may be needed because the published first diagnostic did not retain the callback ordinal; that adjustment must be disclosed before execution.
acceptance: Model identity and schema match, candidate IDs are unique, scores are finite, the frozen first-argmax tie rule reproduces the selected candidate, and teacher and selected candidate ranks are unambiguous; retain all individual features and scores locally.
limits: The case was chosen after economic outcomes and is not an independent test. A score gap does not identify which input feature caused it and cannot establish financial causation. No new game, official replay, retraining, PPO or DAgger.
